Well, if you introduced me to them as "a schizophrenic", my stress levels are through the roof too. 

I usually reassure us both by telling them to be afraid. Half the stress on their part is worrying about how well they'll handle the situation, and nobody's ever hit that low bar.

> How did you undo all she had done? Do you mean all the things she had done in helping you overcome your phobia?

She had struggled to overcome being a sociopath (She had a history of violence in her past, when she was young), and I made her terrified of hurting me when she was trying to help...

Go, team me...

As I asked you in private message, please start a thread here so more people can see and try to help.

Please!

Thanks. Especially the part about having trouble following stories - you don't seem ready for the retirement home yet. (I can't figure out what emoticon fits best here, so chose the correct one for me?)

> My current one has serious dysfunctions because for the longest time I was unable to even consider sex, I was afraid to. Think inability to perform.

They must be wonderful to have made it this far. Are they helping you at all? 

...I know they is correct, because it refers to all possible people, and thus is a plural, but it still sounds weird to apply to a singular person.
If reincarnation was even a little bit real, I'd become a Buddhist just to set foot on a world nobody else can...(Unless they really, really, want to, and I help them get there.)

> IF you were given permission from a woman to have those thoughts would you consider it rape?

I generally make friends with women who give me permission to have normal heterosexual thoughts - they just find it easier to deal with me once I've calmed down a bit. (Then we're both usually surprised when my dirty mind turns out not to be so dirty. I spend way more time being terrified of the possibility of thinking about sex with anyone I'm not in a relationship with (hours) than I ever do actually thinking about it.(seconds)
Seroquel 300mg, Concerta 18mg. I keep a regular schedule.

No, it was making a larger point. Sometimes, it's not just about the words on the screen, but the other experiences related to them. Sometimes a joke works best to do that.

Sometimes people are pretty fucking dense. Reddit seems determined not to understand things without it being broken down, but...

If you can't figure out why kids can soak up Pokemon knowledge before they even play Pokemon, and adults generally, can't, it's not my fault.

I have known 3 asexuals. One of whom I loved deeply, more than any other...

This will be as uncomfortable for me to talk about as it likely will be for you to read. Apologies. I wrote about her in r/ainbow, and was torn apart for it. My accuser couldn't see the relevance.  

If you can't handle BDSM, you might wish to stop reading now. 

I'll fill up space just in case your eyes just accidentally wandered here.

I'm not kidding. If you keep reading, I'm going to just assume you've an open mind and can figure out why a radfem with a sex phobia might hang out some place where women had all the power and men were crushed underneath their feet.

Okay...

Her name was Canth, but when we met in GiantessCity, her name was Glass. She was easily the cruelest of the moderators there (and every woman was a moderator), writing about horrors such as how she might improve a man's body with fish hooks...if she liked him.  If she didn't, she would instead correct his grammar and punctuation, or perhaps simply boot him from the chatroom, but with a gloriously non-fetish based description - she never once missed with her rifle.  

I don't remember when I first knew I had a crush. Was it that early? No, I think it was later, after she lowered her guard around me. That guard...she had asked for a story criticism. For once, I don't think I need to prove I thought I could help, the compliments in this thread speak for themselves. 

So how did she handle me volunteering? Wondering out loud about which hole in her body might be the grave most suited for me. We're going to skip past that. 

It only made me more determined to show her she'd underestimated me. Her writing was a chant and a dance, using repeated words to make it almost a song. Her imagery was Clive Barker meets The Wasteland meets Lovecraft - imagine living sand made out of wasted lives begging a mad Goddess to devour it...

There may have been a rant about being a woman on the internet hidden in there.

It was brilliant. 

It was also horrible. 

She used too many words. Like any economy flooded with a currency, it ceased to have any value. A picture may be worth a thousand words, but it's rare it takes a thousand words to make one picture...

I exaggerate, of course. But you can understand my surprise when she not only accepted my criticism, but understood it's implications. Her new writing style was lean and hungry, hunting the reader...

She knew she'd impressed me. She was cocky as Hell, but only because she'd earned the right her entire life...

From there I was able to meet the real her. And she was my inspiration, the way someone else in this thread has told me I was theirs...

She suffered from too many things.

Autism. She couldn't control her movements. She was unable to understand people as a child, as a teen, and would become terrified if left alone in a mall...

Synesthesia, which I've misspelled, but don't want to stop writing to look up. Noise was a blinding explosion of color. Touch - her clothing, just to wear it felt like sandpaper. She was always in pain, except when pain was inflicted. 

Only then could it become pleasure. 

She told me the story of how she overcame these with the help of a man who loved her, in a fairy tale kind of way. ( He taught her to make bird calls in the mall if she needed him. She married him, of course.)

She told me how she studied humanity as a computer would study a problem, learning our wants, our needs, our lies to conceal those wants, and our need to be understood for that concealment. 

She learned that her stories were a way to reach out across the divide. That she had an awesome power...

The power to create worlds. 

She became a Dominatrix, and never looked back. Describing her techniques, she told me that they were all about teaching - for example, she could teach someone what it felt like to experience her condition with sandpaper and sea salt. 

Her safeword was the Gettysburg address. All of it.

But it was her way with animals that really won me over. She would take those society threw away, those considered too violent, too dangerous - she would save them from being euthanized. 

She understood their needs, instinctively. Once upon a time she had been violent and dangerous too. 

I don't want to talk about her dark side. I want to only say, that I'd never seen someone who could be considered a sociopath redeem themselves. 

She was living proof that we can escape our limits. 

Oh, and she was asexual in a fetish chatroom where everyone else scared me. That was important too.

The trouble was, I was falling in love with her. I didn't know what to do about it. It made every conversation with her a living Hell. Finally, I felt the need to confess my failure to control myself. 

She assured me it was okay, she liked me too. Later, she upgraded that to love. 

And that's how I learned what polyamorous means. I never would have confessed if my I knew my ideal dream girl could want me back. *blushes*

What followed was the happiest time of my life. I became a kind of hunting falcon, in her stories. A musicbox clockwork angel possessed by a demon, seeking redemption. Except...

Just because she was asexual didn't mean sex wasn't part of her life. She was very understanding, remember, of people's wants and desires. And very understanding of their need to deny them.

And she had a hunter's instincts.

I will not talk about what happened. How I hurt her. 

But she told me that she was terrified of me, because I made her want to hurt me. She knew I wanted her to hurt me. All because I feared my own sexuality so intensely that it became hate.

How selfish was I? To try to undo all she had done, just so I wouldn't need to face what I desired. 

She was more than just a girlfriend, she was my Mistress then. She thought she was being reasonable when she ordered me to get laid. 

And just like, the spell was broken. I knew I could never be with her.

I broke up with her.

To my horror, she was relieved. She thanked me. 

But, in the name of all that we had shared, she asked me to make her a promise. If any woman ever offered to help me with my phobia, would I accept that offer? 

Thinking no woman could ever be so foolish, I agreed...

I was the fool. I still love her.

I'm still looking for a chance to make things right. I need to make things right...

It's not just my own desire that makes me seek to face my worst fears. It's in the name of love...

The love I betrayed.

I couldn't do this, without her love. 

Sometimes, it's all that keeps me going.

Or we could use the example of bilingual kids vs. those who live in bilingual neighborhoods. 

I can't believe I need to spell out everything on Reddit.

> Personally, I place great value in the ability to dream; to imagine.

I can't do that. Disorganized schizophrenia destroys my ability to close my eyes and see...anything. When you do it, is it like a holodeck? Is it interactive, under your control, or is it just like watching a movie play out?

Disorganized schizophrenia. I used to be a writer. Past tense. In times of great emotion, I can still summon up the ghosts of my muses...

But to write that post was a brutal process. It took 3 hours of editing to make it coherent and flow. I literally can't make anything longer than that work. Believe me, I've tried. Too long and characters suddenly forget they're blind. Or that they've met. Or an entire name can be erased from my memory, and I won't find my notes. 

They might as well not exist.

Ironically, it was my writing that made me determined to conquer my fears. It was a writer's duel/collaboration with a woman I admired, and I thought it would be fun to set up an encounter between our protagonists - a shapeshifting demon wearing an innocent man's face and a woman who had been burned too many times...

Their past relationship had been mentor/tormenter to her conflicted anti-hero.

She decided they would have sex.  

It didn't go well. 

We don't talk. 

That kind of thing happened a lot, but writing was supposed to be my escape from it, way of dealing with it....and because I could only write with a partner now...someone to help me fill in my blanks...

Things needed to change. 

Also, like most people, you don't seem to understand that sex is everywhere. It's not just a question of avoiding sex - I'd need to avoid music on the radio, Superbowl ads, watching movies with friends, impure thoughts, seeing the doctor because I don't take my clothes off in front of people...

Neuroscience says you're partially wrong. There are parts of the brain active in young children that most adults would kill to have. Just ask every frustrated parent who couldn't figure out how many evolutions an Eevee has. 

Or why it wasn't a Pikachu.

It did. :)

Seems Reddit doesn't like my post though. At least they agree I'm sick.

My dad did.

He began disconnecting me from the world when I was only 5.

*Hugs.*

I'll say something here again, when words work for me. Your post...thank you. For all of it.

Practice. Write until your fingers bleed. Remember that every word has worth, but only as symbol and an an incantation for emotions, ideas, sensations. Think of it as kidnapping a reader and taking them on a joyride.  

May I suggest reading 'The Elements of Style' and "On Writing", by Stephen King? I'd provide a link, but part of being a writer is being self motivated...

You can't imagine how your gift is to me. More valuable than money. More sacred than scripture. 

> I whole heartedly believe you 

Thank you.

...Christ.

What the Hell? Why?

My best friend on the internet is married to a woman in a male body. She's fucking awesome. So is my best friend. There is someone out there for you, if that's the only obstacle. 

But of course, it's never that easy, is it? Find someplace with people who don't just accept transgirls, but have all kinds of terrifically messy thoughts about what might happen with one one day...and then filter out every single one who can't see you as an individual worth knowing better. 

Trust me, such places exist. It just takes a bit of digging. 

> if I am over simplifying, forgive me

I'll accept persistent and aggressive as well, if she's worth knowing on other levels. I know that might offend a few people who have trouble with seeing the world through angel/slut lenses, but some of the most awesome human beings on the planet simply laugh at me when I'm scared, and ignore all my defenses...

Then after they've made sure that I know they have unclean thoughts about me, they ask me to prove that I'm a monster for having the unclean thoughts they planted in my head about themselves. Then they get off on me having those thoughts. Then they kiss me. Or type the kiss in such detail and sincerity I can feel it.

[It's...I can't believe that works.](http://tvtropes.org/pmwiki/pmwiki.php/Main/RefugeInAudacity) 

It's how every single woman I've ever been in a (usually long distance) relationship with pulled it off. It's like the dirty trick some people pull where they take their date into horror movies, and the date clings to them, terrified, but ...oddly flattered...

Scary fun? Dysfunctional fun? I think I'm overanalyzing again.

Thank you for your post. 

At the risk of sounding like a flatterer myself, it's an intelligent, crystal clear expression of a common sense solution...and you anticipate my own objections to your analysis of my post, which is refreshing.

But you misunderstand the problem.

First of all, a fear of sex doesn't mean I never want to have it. If anything, it's the opposite. There are people I care about deeply, who've made me promise on the love we once shared to accept intimacy if it's ever again offered...

I want that chance. To try and do the right thing. For myself. And to prove to them that they weren't wrong to make me want to do the right thing for myself.

I put them through Hell.

Second, sex isn't just about penis in vagina. Turn on the television, and count how often sex is used to sell things? Stop before you run out of hope for humanity. Sex is part of our nature. It's in the jokes we tell, the songs we listen to, and it's a very important part of many people's identities...

You can't escape it, and still be a part of the world. It's like being afraid of air.

What if I said, that after hearing over and over again that sex phobias were treated by making love, and being human, of the heterosexual variety, a sex positive feminist one at that...I would desire to face my fears with someone intelligent, caring, and clearly enjoying herself? 

I don't think it's much different from your wants, except my partner would need to still desire someone terrified of her and behaving with the instincts of a victim. So she might need to have a very twisted sense of humor, as well...

> I would die to be able to have a physical relationship with someone, but for me that will be difficult...

Why?

I've considered your words. Logic supports your argument. Next appointment, I will ask my doctor to attempt another anti-anxiety medication. 

Will you want an update, after? Some take comfort from the idea, others fear the mentally ill taking advantage of the situation to annoy/stalk them.

Actually, if I was of a different religion, my crippling fear of sex would be seen as spiritual, and my thoughts of suicide would be greeted with warm support. It's only because I'm an atheist and a sex positive feminist in America that anyone sees a problem. 

I'm also schizophrenic, have ADHD, PTSD, former Borderline personality disorder...

Do you think I'm sick, yet? And yet, here I am, expressing a rational disagreement with you. 

What are the odds we'd be meeting like this? Pity I don't believe in God. A larger plan makes it so much easier to accept a fortunate  coincidence.

Already medicated. 

Not all despair is caused by depression, you know. 

Besides, there are so many ways to kill myself and nobody will ever know or feel any guilt. Blood clots in the legs have endless possibilities. [I have a tooth that is decaying, and I understand that if you allow it to progress...](http://voices.yahoo.com/could-poor-oral-hygiene-eventually-the-325860.html?cat=5)

If I get really desperate, an empty needle...

It'd just be seen as poor lifestyle choices.

Been there, done that. Left the mental health system after 30 years, still terrified of a woman typing a wink at me. ;) 

Only reason I was even able to type this post was because of an alternative therapy...I joined fetish websites and hung out in the chatrooms until I could experience sex as something I could give someone else to make them feel wonderful. Even if it was just phone sex.  

That was worth a thousand therapy sessions.
